title: COCO Celebrations

secondaryMetrics: Next milestone (days until, with first name and years)
Celebrating this week (Sun-Sat, includes earlier days this week)
content.defaultList: Anniversaries this month for the selected role, sorted by date, auto-scrolled to today; earlier days this month shown muted
content.search: All 3,531 roster entries by name or manager name; results sorted by next anniversary; first 100 shown

statusStates.Happy Anniversary!: Anniversary date equals today (exact date only); purple chip with pulse dot; light confetti once per role per day
statusStates.Milestone: Years of service is 1, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 or 30+; gold chip with sheen
statusStates.Coming Up: Future anniversary; purple when inside the current week, grey otherwise

content.leapDayRule: Feb 29 anniversaries fall on Feb 28 in non-leap years
content.newHires: Shown as Coming Up with 1 yr when their first anniversary falls in view; anniversaries under 1 year excluded

data.primaryParamNote: Deferred; roster has no employee or location IDs. Widget shows the same view to everyone.

fieldsEmbedded: Job Title (only when it differs from the role's base title)
dataSource.refresh: Rebuild the HTML when the roster changes
dataSource.hosting: Contains employee names and service dates: host only on a private, access-controlled location

data.refreshNote: 1-second tick re-renders on calendar-day rollover; no network calls

display.sizing: With no aspectRatio param (or aspectRatio=fill) the widget fills 100% of the iframe width and height and adapts as it resizes. A named ratio draws the largest box of that shape that fits the iframe, centered.
display.renderingContext: Any: phone tile, tablet, desktop, kiosk or lobby screen

layoutTiers.under 400px wide: single column, stats stacked (shown only when 480px+ tall)
layoutTiers.700px+ wide: hero and stats side by side, multi-column list
layoutTiers.1100px+ wide and 600px+ tall: larger type for desktop and kiosk

display.compactRules: Stats hide below 380px tall; hero hides below 300px tall and its count moves into the header; search hides below 190px tall

fileSizeNote: Under the 150 KB target: roster packed (base-36 dates, indexed managers and titles) at about 99 KB, logo about 31 KB
